rankings.metaDesc: Cancellation-friction scores for services with a completed evidence breakdown, including steps, retention prompts, required channels and disclosed fees.
rankings.title: Cancellation friction
rankings.intro: We publish a 0–10 score only after completing the evidence breakdown for that service. Scores reflect the observable factors recorded on the date shown next to each entry. Services without a completed breakdown remain available as cancellation guides but are excluded from this index.
rankings.methodDesc: Each public cancellation flow is timed by a real person on a fresh browser session. The 0–10 score is a weighted average of these observable signals.
rankings.reportInaccuracyDesc: Send us a screenshot or describe what changed. We re-test within 7 business days and update the date stamp.
rankings.easyNote: These services make leaving about as easy as joining — same number of clicks, no retention prompts.
rankings.disclaimer: Scores reflect our team's hands-on testing of public cancellation flows. They are our opinion based on documented methodology, not a legal assessment. Service flows change without notice — every entry shows the date it was last verified. We re-test on request from anyone (including the companies covered) within 7 business days.

about.title: About CancelHub
about.intro: CancelHub is a free resource that helps you cancel subscriptions without the headaches — no dark patterns, no upsells, just clear steps.
about.missionBody: Subscription services make cancellation intentionally difficult. We document every trick they use and give you the exact steps to get out — on every platform.
about.howBody: Every guide is researched and verified by going through the actual cancellation flow. We check each guide regularly and update it when services change their process.
about.freeBody: CancelHub is and will always be free. We don't take money from subscription companies, don't run ads, and don't have referral deals. Our only goal is to help you cancel.
about.contactBody: Found a guide that's out of date, or want to suggest a new service?
